privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: NowHere is a personal project and portfolio app. It is not a company or a GmbH, and there is no data protection officer.
privacy.whoBody: Data lives on the machine that runs this app’s docker compose stack (databases, object storage, and mail). Whoever operates that machine is the one holding the data. There is no separate cloud product or third-party controller for this project.
privacy.dataBody: An account stores email, name, bio, a password hash, and an optional profile photo. We also store visibility settings, snaps you post (photo object keys, caption, tag, and location), snaps you have opened, bookmarks, and reports you send. Photo files are object-storage keys, not public website URLs.
privacy.locationBody: Location is used only after you agree: to show snaps near you and to attach a snap you post to that place. The app does not request GPS until that checkbox is ticked. Location is not sold.
privacy.mailBody: Reset messages go through the mail host configured on this compose stack. In development that is a local inbox (Mailhog), not a production email provider.
privacy.rightsBody: From Settings you can export a JSON copy of your account data and delete your account. Deletion removes your profile, snaps, and stored photos. If a deletion is interrupted, the account stays disabled so you can retry.
privacy.contactBody: There is no company support desk. Contact the person who runs this compose stack.
